4th Period.workingNow: Confirming your fork worked and turning on GitHub Pages so your site goes live.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: GitHub account created, starter repo forked, and GitHub Pages live with your first name and one image on the home page — no other personal info.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can enable GitHub Pages on my forked repo so that my site is published on the internet.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.17 — Systematically test and refine programs using a range of test cases.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.1 — Exchanging information and ideas with others through collaborative discussions.
agenda: Warm-Up: Chromebooks out, repo open (3 min)
I do: teacher demos enabling Pages in Settings (5 min)
You do: enable Pages & find your live URL (12 min)
Troubleshoot in pairs if your site doesn't load (7 min)
Exit Ticket: Submit your live site link in Google Classroom (3 min)
4th Period.connections: Yesterday you forked your own copy of the repo. Today that copy goes live on the internet for the first time. Tomorrow we start actually editing what's on the page.

6th Period.workingNow: Adding a navigation menu to your Google Site and confirming your links work.
6th Period.weeklyDeliverable: Google Site home page live with a nav menu and one image, and the Getting to Know You survey submitted.
6th Period.smartGoal: I can add a navigation menu to my site so that visitors can find new pages I create.
6th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.13 — Create prototypes using structured code, organized into separate linked pages, to fulfill a design requirement.
6th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.1 — Exchanging information and ideas with others through collaborative discussions.
agenda: Warm-Up: One thing you like about your site so far (3 min)
I do: teacher shows adding a menu link (4 min)
We do: add a nav menu together (5 min)
You do: finish your nav menu & confirm links work (13 min)
Exit Ticket: Submit updated site link in Google Classroom (5 min)
6th Period.connections: Yesterday you built your home page and told us about yourselves in the survey. Today we make your site navigable. Tomorrow we'll use what we learned about each other to browse everyone's sites.
